title: Two stores, same product. Why one wins.
caption: Same product. Same supplier. One store wins every time. 3 rounds: headline, proof, offer. Plus the prompt to score your own store. #ecommerce #shopifytips #conversionrate #aitools

beats.headline: Same product. | *Different* sales.
beats.say: Two stores sell the *exact* same product. One makes way more sales. Let me show you why.

beats.headline: Score your *store*
beats.say: I'll judge them side by side, then hand you the *prompt* to score your own store.
beats.box: the prompt to score your own store.

beats.headline: Same supplier. | *Different* results.
beats.say: [sigh] Same supplier. Same price. Totally different *results.*

beats.headline: The last one | decides the *sale.*
beats.say: Three rounds. The last one decides the *sale.*
Round one, the headline. The left store says, premium posture support. The *right* store says, stand straighter in fourteen days. One sells a thing. The other sells a *result.*
Round two, proof. The left store has four reviews, buried at the bottom. The *right* store shows a real customer video before you even *scroll.*
Round three, the offer. The left store shows a price, and that's it. The *right* store adds a two-pack deal, free shipping, and a thirty-day guarantee. It *removed* the risk.
[laughter] Final score. Headline, proof, offer. Three to zero. And that product isn't even *better.*

visual.prompt: Here are 2 product pages: mine and a competitor's. Score headline, proof and offer. Who wins each round? Give fixes.

beats.say: Now score yours. *Paste* your product page and a competitor's into any AI. Ask it to judge headline, proof, and offer, and give you the exact fix for every round you lose.

beats.headline: Better *pitch*, | not product.
beats.say: They didn't win with a better product. They won with a better *pitch.*

beats.label: Score your store
beats.headline: Follow for *more*
beats.say: *Save* this, score your store tonight, and follow for more teardowns like this.
